about_the_game:
Five Nights at Dream

An erotic survival game inspired by the classic Five Nights at Freddy’s formula—where tension, fear, and raw lust intertwine in a nightmarishly seductive setting.

Story

The story begins when the protagonist is asked for a strange favor: to work five consecutive nights as a security guard in the now-abandoned venue known as “Dream.” But this is no ordinary job. The location is haunted by four sensual female ghosts trapped in a supernatural time loop, and the only way to free them is to endure each night while helping them resolve their unfinished business. Though their appearance is eerie and their behavior unpredictable, they are intensely lewd, alluring, and dangerously seductive—even when they’re trying to scare you.

Gameplay

Gameplay centers around classic night-watch mechanics: monitor the cameras, manage power and resources, and survive until 6:00 AM. Fail, and instead of dying, you’ll be overtaken by lust. Losing a night triggers fully animated NSFW scenes where the ghosts take control of the protagonist’s body in highly explicit and supernatural ways.

Content

The full game offers around two hours of intense, adult-focused gameplay, with a dark horror atmosphere underscored by a chilling soundtrack. Erotic scenes are fully voiced by professional voice actresses, featuring moans, whispers, and screams that heighten immersion. As you progress, you’ll unlock these scenes in a gallery mode, allowing you to revisit each sensual possession at any time.

An additional game mode will allow players to customize the difficulty and behavior of each ghost, adjusting the experience from mild tension to overwhelming lust-driven chaos.

Five Nights at Dream is a fully adult, NSFW experience combining horror, storytelling, and raw erotic energy into a supernatural thrill like no other.
